guarantees.claim: idle_o is continuously assigned to idle_q.

assumptions.claim: When a message FIFO write request is active (msg_fifo_req & msg_fifo_we), the write mask wmask_byte must be byte-aligned, i.e., equal to '0 or '1.
assumptions.cond: posedge clk with rst_n asserted (not reset)
assumptions.risk: A misaligned mask can corrupt data written to the HMAC, breaking integrity and potentially causing security-critical data loss.

uncertain_points.claim: The byte-alignment assumption is enforced only as a simulation/formal property (disabled by `ifndef VERILATOR / SYNTHESIS`). In synthesized hardware, a misaligned wmask_byte can propagate directly into the FIFO write logic without error detection.
uncertain_points.cond: When the chip is in operational hardware (synthesis) or verilator build
uncertain_points.risk: A malicious master or hardware fault may issue misaligned writes, potentially corrupting message data in the HMAC and exposing or modifying secrets.
